# Richard Muscat Azzopardi

> Personal site of Richard Muscat Azzopardi: CEO of Switch, a B2B brand and
> marketing consultancy; Vistage Chair; strategy consultant and fractional
> CMO to a small number of US and UK companies. Stanford Graduate School of
> Business, Executive Leadership Program, 2022. Based in Gozo, Malta.

Richard writes in the first person, signs off as Rik, and this site never
names a client and never publishes client work — the methodology appears
as open, reusable guides instead of case studies.

## Who this is

Richard Muscat Azzopardi runs Switch (switch.com.mt) with his brother Ed,
chairs a Vistage peer-advisory group of business leaders, and works
directly with a handful of owner-led manufacturing and technology companies
as a strategy consultant and fractional CMO, mostly in the US and the UK.
He also coaches CFOs across the US with Dope CFO and guest lectures on
marketing at Northeastern University's D'Amore-McKim School of Business.
The thesis running through the writing on this site: growth and kindness
are not a trade-off, and the best businesses grow because of how they
treat people, not in spite of it.

## What's on this site

- **Writing** — essays on marketing, strategy, and running a business
  people actually want to work for and buy from. First person, specific,
  no stock imagery, no sales pitch at the end.
- **Playbooks** — open-source, practical guides distilled from Richard's
  consulting work, including the 20-Point Commercial Analysis, a framework
  for auditing a company's commercial function. Free to use on your own
  business; no client names or case studies attached to any of them.
- **About** — Richard's background: Switch, Vistage, Stanford, and the
  publishing career that came before all of it.
- **Now** — a quarterly-updated note on what he's currently working on and
  thinking about.
